name: nginx-multisite
description: Provisions Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, deploys static site content, and configures security controls including fail2ban, UFW, sysctl hardening, SSH restrictions, and development self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and logging, and applies the required Redis post-configuration settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application in a virtual environment, provisions its PostgreSQL database and user, and runs it under systemd with Uvicorn.
